column2: Ku buntu kuri Android, Windows na Linux.
Andika, ohereza kandi urangize kwishyura buri paki — sisitemu imwe y’amapaki ku bikoresho byawe.

Abafatanyabikorwa, ibitabo, COD, ibirango, amatsinda ya nimero za AWB, gukurikirana, abamotari n’inyemezabuguzi — uruziga rwose kuva kuri kontwari kugeza kwishyurwa, hari interineti cyangwa idahari. Ku buntu ku bikoresho byawe.
Uburemere nyabwo n’uburemere bw’ingano, iruhande rumwe.
Urutonde rwawe rw’ibiciro, amafaranga mu ntoki cyangwa konti.
Gukanda rimwe bisukura kontwari ku wundi uhageze.
Manura — umurongo w’urugendo rw’ipaki uri hejuru werekana aho ugeze mu nkuru.
Uburemere nyabwo cyangwa ubw’ingano — ubunini kurusha ubundi, buzengurutswe uko ubishaka.
Ingano y’agasanduku ni yo igena amafaranga.
Ubunini muri bibiri, buzamurwa kugeza kuri 0,5 kg ikurikira.

Muri porogaramu, iduka ni ryo rishyiraho igabanya, intambwe yo kuzengurutsa n’ibipimo byawe (cm cyangwa inci, kg cyangwa lb). Buto ya Mu mahanga ikoresha ÷6000 ku iyandikwa rimwe utakoze kuri Igenamiterere.
Intonde zawe z’ibiciro, ibiciro by’abafatanyabikorwa bawe — n’inyungu yawe kuri buri rupapuro rw’ipaki.
Urwego rwa mbere na buri rwego rwiyongeraho, kuri buri karere na serivisi.
Abohereza kenshi babona ibiciro byabo; urutonde rusanzwe rureba abandi bose.
Igiciro cyawe cyo kugurisha ugereranyije n’igiciro cy’umwikorezi, kuri buri rupapuro rw’ipaki.
AWB ivuye mu matsinda yawe ya nimero. Shyiraho ikirango, sikana, ubone.
Amatsinda ya nimero kuri buri mwikorezi
Andika urukurikirane rwa mbere–rwa nyuma rwa buri mwikorezi rimwe; buri yandikwa rifata nimero ikurikira.
AWB ishyirwa ku gasanduku nka barcode no mu mibare isanzwe.
Sikana ikirango kugira ngo ufungure urupapuro rwacyo kandi ukore igikwiye.
Bishyikirize umwikorezi, cyangwa wohereze umumotari wawe. Sisitemu imwe.
Urutonde rw’amapaki rurimo neza amapaki wahisemo — yose cyangwa nta na rimwe. Ipaki yanditswe ku wundi mwikorezi ntishobora kwinjira muri uyu mufuka.
Hitamo amapaki, capa urupapuro rw’urugendo, maze umumotari akorere muri porogaramu imwe mu buryo bw’umumotari — hamwe n’ikimenyetso cyo kugeza.
Buri cyimuka kirandikwa — kandi ibyimuka bifite ishingiro gusa.

→ impamvu → byongera gusohoka, cyangwa bigasubizwa uwohereje.
Byagejejwe, byasubijwe na byahagaritswe ni iherezo.
Ifoto n’umukono w’uwakiriye ku rupapuro rw’ipaki.
Impamvu, inshuro zageragejwe, byongera gusohoka, cyangwa gusubira ku wohereje.
COD ushobora kubona: ateganyijwe, yatanzwe, abereyemo buri wohereza.
Amafaranga mu ntoki y’umumotari, iherezo ry’urugendo
Ibura rya ₹ 200 kuri Umumotari B — ryagaragajwe, ntiryazimiriye mu giteranyo.
Ayakiriwe ugereranyije n’ayishyuwe, kuri buri wohereza, hamwe n’amatsinda y’amafaranga yoherejwe.
Ateganyijwe ugereranyije n’ayatanzwe, n’urupapuro rwa komisiyo.
Igitabo cy’umunsi, inyemezabuguzi y’ukwezi kuri buri konti, n’incamake ya GST muri CSV ku mucungamari wawe.
Kwandika, ibirango, gusikana, COD n’ibitabo byose bikora ku bikoresho byawe. Iyo interineti ivuyeho, nta kintu kuri kontwari kiyitegereza.

Ku buntu iteka ryose ku bikoresho byawe
